lead.description: a regression that lets coefficients vary across groups, including groups that sit inside other groups

self_checks.title: Clinic variance
self_checks.prompt: A random intercept has variance 9 and the residual variance is 3. What are the marginal variance and the within-clinic correlation?
self_checks.answer: The marginal variance is 12 and the correlation is 9/12 = 0.75.

self_checks.title: Within-clinic difference
self_checks.prompt: With residual variance 3, what is the variance of the difference of two observations that share a random intercept?
self_checks.answer: The shared intercept cancels, so the variance is 3 + 3 = 6.

self_checks.title: Another intercept
self_checks.prompt: A random intercept has variance 4 and the residual variance is 12. What are the marginal variance, the within-group correlation, and the variance of a within-group difference?
self_checks.answer: The marginal variance is 16, the correlation is 0.25, and the difference has variance 24.

overview_sentence: A [multilevel model](articles/multilevel-model.qmd) lets regression coefficients vary across groups that may themselves be grouped.
